apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flink-jobmanager
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flink

    metadata:
      labels:
        app: flink
        component: jobmanager
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: zep-flink-eks-kt-svcacct
      containers:
      - name: jobmanager
        image: docker.io/kthyagar/ktflink
        workingDir: /opt/flink
        command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - $FLINK_HOME/bin/jobmanager.sh start;while :; do if [[ -f $(find log -name
          '*jobmanager*.log' -print -quit) ]]; then tail -f -n +1 log/*jobmanager*.log;
          fi; done
        env:
        - name: blahblah
          value: blahblah
        - name: blahblah
          value: blahblah
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6123
          name: rpc
        - containerPort: 6124
          name: blob
        - containerPort: 8081
          hostPort: 8081
          name: ui
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6123
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 60
        volumeMounts:
        - name: flink-config-volume
          mountPath: /opt/flink/conf
        securityContext:
          runAsUser: 0
      volumes:
      - name: flink-config-volume
        configMap:
          name: flink-config
          items:
          - key: flink-conf.yaml
            path: flink-conf.yaml
          - key: log4j.properties
